author: marlon-chaviano
name: discord-bot
title: Discord bot
description: A Discord bot with discord.js and TypeScript: slash commands with their registration, events and environment variables ready to go.
setupTasks: Discord: create the application at discord.com/developers, copy the bot token into `DISCORD_TOKEN` and the Application ID into `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID`; then `npm run deploy-commands`.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each slash command is an entry in `src/commands.ts` (`data` with `SlashCommandBuilder` and `execute`). After adding or changing one: `npm run deploy-commands`.
- Request only the *intents* you need in `src/index.ts`; privileged ones (messages, members) must be enabled in the portal.
- Respond to every interaction within 3 seconds or use `deferReply()`.
- Develop with `npm run dev`. Before finishing: `npm run build`.
